changes: Built for Apple Silicon: UnetLoaderGGUF with the Unsloth Q4_K_M distilled transformer and the bf16 Gemma 4 12B text encoder instead of the int8 ConvRot files (CUDA kernels), the conv bf16 video VAE, small drafts (stage 1 at half size). The layout clip (conformed on the server: 24 fps, 8k+1 frames, cover-crop to the draft size) guides both stages through LTXVAddGuide with the IC-LoRA parameters; the art-directed first frame is VAE-encoded and added with LTXVAddLatentGuide at latent_idx -1 (before the clip) on both stages; guides are cropped before the x2 latent upscale and before decode. Stage 1: 8 distilled sigmas; stage 2: 0.909375, 0.725, 0.421875, 0. CFG 1, euler_ancestral, seed 42 (stage 2 seed + 1). Audio: LTX-2.5's own generated sound is kept (no source audio).
